messages.text: Service dispatch needs one defensible decision for advance-replacement return by 2026-01-14; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside sales order, RMA, original serial, replacement serial, and receipt organization.
I found 70 SERIALS on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0085 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000085 up to 65 SERIALS, provided sales order, RMA, original serial, replacement serial, and receipt organization. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or close_without_return.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for depot receiving window is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R9 and the CASE-086 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-085.

Required closeout records: record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell; and post the decided option, date, constraint, alternatives, and Oracle reference in the existing operations thread. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
